sources.title: GLM 5.3 Flash API & Playground | Fireworks AI
sources.snippet: GLM-5.3-Flash is the first natively multimodal model in the GLM-5 series with 320B total parameters and 18B active parameters. It incorporates several architectural improvements over GLM-5.2 including a hybrid architecture, sharply reducing long-context serving costs while preserving precise long-context and Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections (mHC) to further improve scaling efficiency.

sources.title: wtdcode/GLM-5.3-Flash-AWQ-W4A16 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Copy to bucket new GLM-5.3-Flash-AWQ-W4A16 What is quantized GLM-5.3-Flash-AWQ-W4A16 Quantized version of zai-org/GLM-5.3-Flash. What is quantized Weight-only INT4 (symmetric, group size 128) via AWQ, stored in the compressed-tensors pack-quantizedformat. Calibrated from the official FP8 release (dequantized to BF16 first).

sources.title: cyankiwi/GLM-5.3-Flash-AWQ-INT4 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: GLM-5.3-Flash starts from a newly trained base model, with its architecture and training recipe redesigned around capability and efficiency. For the first time in the GLM series, we introduce a hybrid architecture combining sparse and linear attention, sharply reducing long-context serving costs while preserving precise long-context capabilities.

sources.title: GLM-5.3-Flash - vLLM Ascend
sources.snippet: Quantized model GLM-5.3-Flash-w8a8can be deployed on 2 Atlas 800 A2 (64GB × 8) nodes with DP2 across the two nodes (one DP rank per node) and TP8 inside each node.
